104: func doJSONWrite(w http.ResponseWriter, code int, obj interface{}) {
105: 	w.Header().Set(headers.ContentType, headers.ApplicationJSON)
106: 	w.WriteHeader(code)
107: 	if err := json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(obj); err != nil {
108: 		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
109: 	}
110: 	if code != http.StatusOK {
111: 		job := instrument.NewJob("SystemAPIError")
112: 		job.Event(strconv.Itoa(code))
113: 	}
114: }

116: func doJSONExport(w http.ResponseWriter, code int, obj interface{}, fileName string) {
117: 
118: 	if code != http.StatusOK {
119: 		doJSONWrite(w, code, obj)
120: 		return
121: 	}
122: 
123: 	stream, err := json.MarshalIndent(obj, "", "  ")
124: 
125: 	if err != nil {
126: 		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)

128: 	}
129: 
130: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream")

134:
